audience: n8n is for people who want to see the workflow and keep the option to host it. Developers and technical operators who already think in triggers, branches, and HTTP requests get more from it than someone who wants a finished recipe for every app. If you only need one or two no-code zaps and you never want a server, start with Zapier instead and come back if the task bill bothers you.

The cloud plans are for a team that wants n8n without running it. The community edition is for internal or non-commercial self-hosting under the Sustainable Use License. Those are different decisions. Do not self-host because a blog said it is free, then discover the license does not cover the way you sell it.
features: You pay for a workflow execution, not for every step inside it. That is the main reason builders pick n8n over tools that meter each action. A five-step flow that runs once is one execution. On Zapier, multi-step work and AI steps can cost more than one task. The verdict calls n8n the builder's automation tool for that reason.

Cloud plans include unlimited users. You are not buying a seat for every person who edits a workflow. Starter is the entry cloud plan: €24 a month, or €20 a month billed annually, for 2,500 executions. Pro is €60 a month, or €50 billed annually, for 10,000 executions.

The community edition is royalty-free to self-host for internal or non-commercial use. The license on github.com/n8n-io/n8n is the Sustainable Use License. Business is the paid self-hosted plan: €800 a month, or €667 billed annually, for 40,000 executions. Enterprise is custom. Larger Pro and Business execution packs cost more than the base caps in the table.
limitations: Prices are in euros. If you budget in dollars, convert at the rate you actually pay, not at a round number we invent. The pricing page is the source, and it shows both the monthly amount and the annual rate.

Business is a jump, not a gentle next tier. Pro's annual rate is €50 a month for 10,000 cloud executions. Business's annual rate is €667 a month, and that plan is the self-hosted paid plan with 40,000 executions. If you do not need to host it yourself, do not climb to Business just to get a bigger cloud cap. The page says larger packs exist, and it does not give us a second price to print.

Self-hosting is work. You patch, you back up, and you watch the license. Community is not a blank check for a commercial hosted product. If you are reselling automation, read the Sustainable Use License before you deploy.

faqs.q: Can I self-host n8n for free?
faqs.a: The community edition is royalty-free for internal or non-commercial use under the Sustainable Use License. It is not a promise that every commercial deployment is free. Business is the paid self-hosted plan at €800 a month, or €667 billed annually.
No. Cloud plans meter workflow executions. A run counts once, not once per node. That is the difference with Zapier, where tasks and AI steps can add up inside one Zap.

faqs.q: Does a pending affiliate program change the verdict?
faqs.a: No. n8n is rated Worth it because of the execution pricing and the self-host option, not because of a commission. Sponsorship and affiliate relationships never buy a verdict.
